unitTitle: Prepositions of Place - Was/Were - Had - Could
scanNote:
GRAMMAR 38-BET. Unit 9 nazariyasi — o'rin predloglari, was/were, had, could (mashqsiz bet).

Skaner bilan solishtirildi. Beshta predlog rasmi va uchta jadval (was/were, had, could) to'g'ri ko'chirilgan.

⚠ PREDLOG RASMLARI — SIChQON VA PIShLOQ: between (ikki pishloq orasida), opposite (panjara orqali qarama-qarshi), next to (pishloq yonida), in front of (pishloq oldida), behind (pishloq orqasida).
  ⚠ 'opposite' va 'in front of' farqi shu rasmlarda ko'rinadi: OPPOSITE — biror narsaning narigi tomonida, yuzma-yuz; IN FRONT OF — oldida, lekin yuzma-yuz shart emas.

⚠ UCh JADVALNING FARQI:
  WAS/WERE — egaga qarab O'ZGARADI (I/he/she/it → was; you/we/they → were)
  HAD — barcha shaxsda BIR XIL
  COULD — barcha shaxsda BIR XIL
  ⚠ Ya'ni uchtasidan faqat bittasi o'zgaradi.

⚠ SAVOL VA INKOR UCh XIL YASALADI:
  was/were → o'zi oldinga chiqadi: 'WAS he...?', 'he WASN'T'
  had → 'DID' kerak: 'DID he HAVE?', 'he DIDN'T HAVE'
  could → o'zi oldinga chiqadi: 'COULD he...?', 'he COULDN'T'
  ⚠⚠ ENG KO'P XATO 'had' da: savol va inkorda 'had' emas, 'HAVE' bo'ladi ('Did he had?' XATO).

⚠ QISQA JAVOBDA HAM ShU FARQ: 'Yes, he WAS' · 'Yes, he DID' · 'Yes, he COULD'.

exercises.explanationUz:
Kitobda BESH predlog sichqon va pishloq rasmlari bilan
ko'rsatilgan:

  BETWEEN — sichqon IKKI pishloq ORASIDA o'tiribdi
  OPPOSITE — ikki sichqon panjara orqali YUZMA-YUZ
  NEXT TO — sichqon pishloq YONIDA o'tiribdi
  IN FRONT OF — sichqon pishloqning OLDIDA
  BEHIND — sichqon pishloqning ORQASIDAN qarab turibdi

SXEMA:

     [pishloq]  🐭  [pishloq]      → BETWEEN (orasida)

     🐭 | 🐭                        → OPPOSITE (ro'parasida)
        panjara/ko'cha

     [pishloq] 🐭                   → NEXT TO (yonida)

     🐭 [pishloq]                   → IN FRONT OF (oldida)

     [pishloq] 🐭 (orqasida)        → BEHIND (orqasida)

ENG KO'P ADASHTIRADIGAN JUFT:
  NEXT TO va OPPOSITE
    next to  — YONMA-YON, oralarida hech narsa yo'q
    opposite — YUZMA-YUZ, oralarida ko'cha/panjara BOR

  IN FRONT OF va BEHIND
    in front of — oldida (aksi)
    behind      — orqasida (aksi)

DIQQAT — 'BETWEEN' DOIM 'AND' BILAN:
  The café is between the bank AND the post office.  ✓
  The café is between the bank, the post office.     ✗

DIQQAT — 'OPPOSITE' DA 'TO' KERAK EMAS:
  The school is opposite the cinema.     ✓
  The school is opposite TO the cinema.  ✗

DIQQAT — 'IN FRONT OF' UCH SO'ZDAN IBORAT:
  Uchalasi ham kerak: in + front + of.
  'in front the house' XATO.

sections.title: Was/Were (past simple of the verb "to be")

exercises.instructionEn: Was/Were (past simple of the verb "to be")
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  TASDIQ        SO'ROQ           INKOR
  I was         Was I?           I wasn't
  you were      Were you?        you weren't
  he was        Was he?          he wasn't
  she was       Was she?         she wasn't
  it was        Was it?          it wasn't
  we were       Were we?         we weren't
  you were      Were you?        you weren't
  they were     Were they?       they weren't

KITOBDAGI QOIDALAR:

  • 'to be' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni — WAS.
    WAS ni BIRINCHI va UCHINCHI shaxs BIRLIKDA
    ishlatamiz (I, he, she, it).
    Qolgan barcha shaxslarda WERE ishlatamiz.

  • SO'ROQni was/were + KISHILIK OLMOSHI bilan yasaymiz.
       Where WERE YOU last night?
       (Kecha kechqurun qayerda eding?)

  • INKORni was/were + not bilan yasaymiz.
       He WASN'T at the party last night.
       (U kecha kechqurun ziyofatda emas edi.)

QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Was I/he/she/it ...?
     → Yes, I/he/she/it was.
     → No, I/he/she/it wasn't.
  Were we/you/they ...?
     → Yes, we/you/they were.
     → No, we/you/they weren't.

DIQQAT — 'I' G'ALATI:
  Hozirgi zamonda 'I AM' — alohida shakl.
  O'tgan zamonda 'I WAS' — he/she/it bilan BIR XIL.

DIQQAT — 'YOU' DOIM 'WERE':
  Bitta odamga aytilsa ham WERE:
     You were late, John.  ✓

DIQQAT — 'DID' KERAK EMAS:
  Were you at home?      ✓
  Did you be at home?    ✗ XATO

points.en: I was — Was I? — I wasn't
you were — Were you? — you weren't
he was — Was he? — he wasn't
she was — Was she? — she wasn't
it was — Was it? — it wasn't
we were — Were we? — we weren't
you were — Were you? — you weren't
they were — Were they? — they weren't
The past simple of the verb "to be" is was. We use was with the first and the third persons singular. In all other persons we use were.
points.uz: 'to be' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni — was. Was ni 1- va 3-shaxs birlikda ishlatamiz. Qolgan barcha shaxslarda were.

points.en: We form the interrogative with was/were + subject pronoun. Where were you last night?
points.uz: So'roqni was/were + kishilik olmoshi bilan yasaymiz. Kecha kechqurun qayerda eding?

points.en: We form the negative with was/were + not. He wasn't at the party last night.
points.uz: Inkorni was/were + not bilan yasaymiz. U kecha kechqurun ziyofatda emas edi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 3-QOIDA.
Qisqartma: was not → wasn't;  were not → weren't.

points.en: Yes, I/he/she/it was. — No, I/he/she/it wasn't.
Yes, we/you/they were. — No, we/you/they weren't.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  TASDIQ        SO'ROQ              INKOR
  I had         Did I have?         I didn't have
  you had       Did you have?       you didn't have
  he had        Did he have?        he didn't have
  she had       Did she have?       she didn't have
  it had        Did it have?        it didn't have
  we had        Did we have?        we didn't have
  you had       Did you have?       you didn't have
  they had      Did they have?      they didn't have

KITOBDAGI QOIDALAR:

  • HAD fe'li BARCHA shaxslarda BIR XIL.
  • SO'ROQni DID + EGA + HAVE bilan yasaymiz.
  • INKORni DIDN'T + HAVE bilan yasaymiz.

QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Did I/you/he etc have ...?
     → Yes, I/you/he etc did.
     → No, I/you/he etc didn't.

ENG KO'P UCHRAYDIGAN XATO:
  I didn't HAVE a car.     ✓
  I didn't HAD a car.      ✗ XATO
  Did you HAVE a car?      ✓
  Did you HAD a car?       ✗ XATO

  SABABI: 'did/didn't' allaqachon O'TGAN zamonni
  ko'rsatgan. Bir gapda o'tgan zamon IKKI MARTA
  ko'rsatilmaydi — shuning uchun asosiy fe'l
  ASOSIY shaklda ('have') qoladi.

WAS/WERE BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  'to be' → DID KERAK EMAS:  Were you at home?
  'have'  → DID KERAK:       Did you have a car?

  Bu — eng muhim farq. 'to be' o'zi mustaqil,
  'have' esa yordamchi 'did' ga muhtoj.

QISQA JAVOBDA 'HAVE' TAKRORLANMAYDI:
  Did you have a car? — Yes, I DID.  ✓
  Did you have a car? — Yes, I HAD.  ✗ XATO

points.en: I had — Did I have? — I didn't have
you had — Did you have? — you didn't have
he had — Did he have? — he didn't have
points.noteUz: DIQQAT: hozirgi zamonda 'he HAS', o'tganda 'he HAD' — -S YO'Q.

points.en: she had — Did she have? — she didn't have
it had — Did it have? — it didn't have
we had — Did we have? — we didn't have
you had — Did you have? — you didn't have
they had — Did they have? — they didn't have
The verb had is the same in all persons.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.
Hech qanday -s yoki boshqa shakl yo'q.

points.en: We form the interrogative with did + subject + have.
points.uz: So'roqni did + ega + have bilan yasaymiz.

points.en: We form the negative with didn't + have.
Yes, I/you/he etc did. — No, I/you/he etc didn't.
points.uz: Ha, bor edi. — Yo'q, yo'q edi.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  TASDIQ          SO'ROQ            INKOR
  I could         Could I?          I couldn't
  you could       Could you?        you couldn't
  he could        Could he?         he couldn't
  she could       Could she?        she couldn't
  it could        Could it?         it couldn't
  we could        Could we?         we couldn't
  you could       Could you?        you couldn't
  they could      Could they?       they couldn't

KITOBDAGI QOIDALAR:

  • COULD fe'li BARCHA shaxslarda BIR XIL.
  • SO'ROQni COULD + EGA bilan yasaymiz.
  • INKORni COULD + NOT bilan yasaymiz.

QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Could I/you/he etc ...?
     → Yes, I/you/he etc could.
     → No, I/you/he etc couldn't.

DIQQAT — 'HAD' BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  'had'   so'roqda DID kerak:  Did you have ...?
  'could' so'roqda DID KERAK EMAS:  Could you ...?

  Sababi: 'could' — MODAL fe'l ('can', 'must', 'will' kabi).
  Modal fe'llar o'zi so'roq va inkor yasaydi,
  yordamchi 'do/did' ga muhtoj emas.

DIQQAT — KEYINGI FE'L SHAKLI:
  I could SWIM.        ✓  (asosiy shakl)
  I could TO swim.     ✗ XATO ('to' YO'Q)
  I could SWAM.        ✗ XATO (o'tgan shakl YO'Q)
  I could SWIMMING.    ✗ XATO (-ing YO'Q)

MA'NOSI:
  could = o'tgan zamondagi QOBILIYAT yoki RUXSAT
  I could swim when I was five.
     (Besh yoshimda suza olardim.)
  Children couldn't use the public baths.
     (Bolalar umumiy hammomdan foydalana olmasdi.)

points.en: I could — Could I? — I couldn't
you could — Could you? — you couldn't
he could — Could he? — he couldn't
she could — Could she? — she couldn't
it could — Could it? — it couldn't
we could — Could we? — we couldn't
you could — Could you? — you couldn't
they could — Could they? — they couldn't
The verb could is the same in all persons.
We form the interrogative with could + subject.
We form the negative with could + not.
Yes, I/you/he etc could. — No, I/you/he etc couldn't.
points.uz: Ha, qila olardim. — Yo'q, qila olmasdim.
points.noteUz:
Qisqa javobda 'could/couldn't' takrorlanadi,
asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

wordFormation.introUz: 38-bet — uchta o'tgan zamon shakli va joy predloglari.

groups.explanationUz: Og'zaki nutqda deyarli doim qisqartma ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: Ega + WAS/WERE + ... .   /   WAS/WERE + ega + ...?   /   Ega + WASN'T/WEREN'T + ... .
patterns.exampleEn: He was at home. Where were you last night? He wasn't at the party last night.
patterns.exampleUz: U uyda edi. Kecha kechqurun qayerda eding? U kecha ziyofatda emas edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
I/he/she/it → was;  you/we/they → were.
'did' hech qachon kerak emas.

patterns.formula: Ega + HAD + ot.   /   DID + ega + HAVE + ot?   /   Ega + DIDN'T HAVE + ot.
patterns.exampleEn: They had a car. Did they have a car? They didn't have a car.
patterns.exampleUz: Ularda mashina bor edi. Ularda mashina bormidi? Ularda mashina yo'q edi.
patterns.explanationUz: So'roq va inkorda 'did' KERAK, keyin 'have' (had EMAS).

patterns.formula: Ega + COULD + asosiy fe'l.   /   COULD + ega + asosiy fe'l?   /   Ega + COULDN'T + asosiy fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: She could swim. Could she swim? She couldn't swim.
patterns.exampleUz: U suza olardi. U suza olarmidi? U suza olmasdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'could' modal fe'l — 'did' kerak emas.
Keyingi fe'l 'to' siz, asosiy shaklda.

patterns.formula: The X is BETWEEN the Y AND the Z.
patterns.exampleEn: The mouse is between the two cheeses.

patterns.formula: The X is IN FRONT OF / BEHIND / NEXT TO / OPPOSITE the Y.
patterns.exampleEn: The mouse is in front of the cheese. The mouse is behind the cheese.
patterns.exampleUz: Sichqon pishloq oldida. Sichqon pishloq orqasida.
patterns.explanationUz:
'opposite' dan keyin 'to' KERAK EMAS.
'in front of' — uch so'z, hammasi kerak.
